lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Distributed horizontal-vertical grid of circular high-luminance clusters across the mid-lateral flank, with higher density visible in the lower anterior quadrant relative to the dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, creating a coarse grid-like appearance on the anterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges visible running horizontally along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient between light-reflective upper surfaces and shadowed lower surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of thin, vertical, high-luminance linear markings (scratches) located on the upper flank immediately anterior to the leading edge of the first dorsal fin.
